source.author: verg
source.text: Ea verba locutus optatos dedit amplexus placidumque petivit coniugis infusus gremio per membra soporem.
source.text_original: Ea verba locutus / optatos dedit amplexus placidumque petivit / coniugis infusus gremio per membra soporem.
source.text_english: Having spoken those words, he gave the longed-for embrace and, lying in his wife’s lap, sought peaceful sleep through his limbs.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: da, precor, amplexus haesuraque verba relinque auribus et dulci iam nunc preme lumina dextra.
reuse.text_original: da, precor, amplexus haesuraque verba relinque / auribus et dulci iam nunc preme lumina dextra.
reuse.text_english: Give me, I beg, your embrace, and leave your words to cling to my ears, and now at last close my eyes with your sweet right hand.
